evidence.quote: {{root|en|ine-pro|*leǵ-}} {{ety|en|:uder|frm:intelligent<ety:uder<la:intelligēns>>|id=smart|tree=1}} From {{der|en|frm|intelligent}}, from {{der|en|la|intelligens|intellegēns|discerning}}, present active participle of {{m|la|intellegō||understand, comprehend}}, itself from {{m|la|inter||between}} + {{m|la|legō||choose, pick out, read}}.

c. 1500, a back-formation from intelligence or else from Latin intelligentem (nominative intelligens), present participle of intelligere. In from intelligence or else from Latin intelligentem (nominative intelligens ), present participle of intelligere .
